purpose: Reviewer 4 C6 / Reviewer 3 C5: re-run the learned CT hybrid initializer (MeshGNN E/centre/raw ratio + PCA-Ridge radius; official ratio = bins3(seed-2028 MeshGNN)) on the model-mismatched observations of the 18 locked scenes.

variants.uv_depth: PRIMARY. image_uv_deformed_multiview_seq regenerated by the audit scripts' _reproject (bit-identical to the FEM audits) AND image_depth_deformed_multiview_seq taken from the same project() call, so the MeshGNN flow and depth-delta channels both see the mismatched forward model.
variants.uv_only: Audit-literal. Only image_uv_deformed_multiview_seq replaced (exactly what the FEM audits do); the depth-delta channel still reflects the matched forward model.
variants.stored: matched control: original stored observations (verified identical to a production-solver re-solve to 3e-14 px)
unchanged_fields: image_occlusion_confidence_multiview_seq (confidence channel left as stored, as in the audits)

radius.head: pca_ridge radius head with train-support feature clipping and target clipping

official_ratio.calibration: lung_inverse_rendering.pinn_inverse.official_bins3_regularized applied to the raw seed-2028 ratio

truth_convention: Errors are against the nominal single-sphere generator parameters stored with each scene (same convention as the FEM audits). For two_inclusions the nominal centre is the first sphere; for diffuse the nominal ratio is the Gaussian peak contrast and the nominal radius is its sigma.
